name: darkroom
description: The images Claude reads, writes or makes, and the ones you paste, as a film strip right in the chat: a grey line to unroll, a viewer to browse, a develop under a red safelight (kitty graphics: Ghostty, kitty).

opener.title: darkroom: open images with
opener.description: Command that opens an image; the path is added last. auto: open on macOS, xdg-open elsewhere.

develop.title: darkroom: develop animation
develop.description: Play the safelight develop the first time a strip unrolls.

autoShow.title: darkroom: show the strip without a click
autoShow.description: Unroll the film strip under each row that holds images, without a click.
